text:
maria_cs: Heads-up on NimbusPay — noticed MAU down ~42% MoM, active seats down from 220 -> 128. Renewal in 7 weeks. Need triage and SDR+SE play.
jamal_csm: Thanks — that's a pretty sharp drop. Any correlation with invoice changes or seats being removed?
maria_cs: Procurement flagged a move to CFO-led approvals last week. No pricing changes on our side. They mentioned they're trialing 'AltAI' for a subset of agents. :thinking_face: 
oliver_sales: AltAI mention rings a bell — they sent a pilot quote last month. I have the sales thread, will upload. We should pull recent usage by route (embedding vs chat).
tina_se: Can you paste a quick query to see per-route tokens? I can check for prompt timeouts or model fallbacks.
maria_cs: Quick query from Console analytics:
```
SELECT route, COUNT(*) as calls, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM events
WHERE account = 'nimbuspay' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Result: chat-api 68k tokens, embeddings 9k tokens, bulk-ops 2k. Chat token/sec peaked mid-April then steadily lower.
jamal_csm: So mainly chat usage decline. Any new errors or rate-limit logs?
alerts-bot: [autopilot] alert: increased 429 rate for nimbuspay between 2028-04-10 and 2028-04-13 — peak 6.1% request failure rate.
maria_cs: We had a short burst of 429s when they started a high-volume batch. I spoke with support; threshold bumped temporarily. They might have throttled on their side after.
oliver_sales: Action: I'll offer a two-week dedicated trial on our Dedicated plan to match their throughput and remove noisy throttling as objection. Need pricing ok from finance.
tina_se: If we do Dedicated trial, I can set up a mini-runbook and a 1:1 enablement session to migrate their agent routes, plus a monitoring dashboard.
jamal_csm: Also propose a targeted re-engagement email with top 3 prompts + best-practice for cost/latency (attach snippet).
maria_cs: Agreed. Next steps:
- @oliver_sales to confirm pilot pricing by EOD (2281238000)
- @tina_se to schedule enablement and runbook (sometime this week)
- @jamal_csm to prepare re-engagement play and customer-facing usage graph
- I'll own renewal contact and update CSM exec briefing
I'll cc account exec and put in the renewal playbook. :spiral_calendar:
oliver_sales: on it. If finance pushes back, we'll propose a capped trial cost.
tina_se: I'll draft the runbook and share a calendar invite.
jamal_csm: prepping the email + 7-day usage snapshot.
maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll update the thread once I get procurement contact details. :thumbsup:
